Downard family · Person

Robert Todd Downard

1968–1969

Open in the family tree

Born
October 1, 1968 · Vernal, Utah
Died
June 9, 1969 · Landstuhl, Germany
Burial
Vernal Memorial Park Cemetery

Robert Todd was the oldest son of Robert T. Downard and Judy Maurine Freestone. At four months old, he and his mother joined his father, who was stationed with the Army in Miesau, Germany. Robert Todd died at eight months old at the Second General Hospital in Landstuhl. His funeral was held at the Vernal First and Fifth Ward Chapel.
